headline: The pill and
the troche.
dek: Three ED drugs are FDA approved as tablets. Troches, gummies and combinations are not.
byline: Adonis Men’s Health · Checked Oct 31, 2026 · Clinical review pending

glance.label: Compounded
glance.line: Troches, gums, gummies, strips and combinations: not FDA approved.

glance.label: Not studied
glance.line: No published human study of ED drugs as troches or gummies, or combined with oxytocin.

summary: Three drugs for erectile dysfunction have been through FDA approval, all PDE5 blockers: [[/sildenafil|sildenafil]] (Viagra, 1998), [[/tadalafil|tadalafil]] (Cialis, 2003, later also for an enlarged prostate) and [[/vardenafil|vardenafil]] (Levitra, 2003; that brand is discontinued, not for safety reasons). Generic tablets of all three are approved. Their approvals rest on randomized trials in thousands of men taking the tablets by mouth.

Compounded versions are sold in other forms: troches dissolved in the mouth, gums, gummies, oral strips, and combinations of two ED drugs or of an ED drug with [[/oxytocin|oxytocin]] or [[/bremelanotide|PT-141]]. None is FDA approved, and FDA does not review compounded drugs for safety, effectiveness or quality. A PubMed search found no published human study of sildenafil or tadalafil as a gum, gummy or troche, or combined with oxytocin. The Viagra label says combining it with other PDE5 inhibitors has not been studied and is not recommended.

The added ingredients are approved for other people and other uses. Oxytocin is approved only as an injection, Pitocin, for labor and after birth. PT-141 is approved only as Vyleesi, an injection for premenopausal women with low sexual desire. Use of either in men is off-label. [[/sertraline|Sertraline]], an antidepressant approved since 1991 for six psychiatric conditions, is used off-label for premature ejaculation on the strength of small trials.

What is not known: how the troche, gummy and strip forms behave in the body, whether combinations are safe, and whether oxytocin or PT-141 helps men at all. The human research on oxytocin and male sexual function is a few small studies, mostly a single dose.

pull.quote: VYLEESI is not indicated for the treatment of HSDD in postmenopausal women or in men.

excerpts.quote: Administration of VIAGRA to patients using nitric oxide donors, such as organic nitrates or organic nitrites in any form. VIAGRA was shown to potentiate the hypotensive effect of nitrates
excerpts.note: This is the first item in the label’s list of who must not take it.

excerpts.quote: The safety and efficacy of combinations of VIAGRA with other PDE5 Inhibitors, including REVATIO or other pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) treatments containing sildenafil, or other treatments for erectile dysfunction have not been studied. Such combinations may further lower blood pressure. Therefore, the use of such combinations is not recommended.

Antepartum: Pitocin is indicated for the initiation or improvement of uterine contractions, where this is desirable and considered suitable for reasons of fetal or maternal concern, in order to achieve vaginal delivery.
excerpts.note: Pitocin is the only FDA-approved form of oxytocin.

excerpts.quote: VYLEESI is a melanocortin receptor agonist indicated for the treatment of premenopausal women with acquired, generalized hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD)
excerpts.note: Bremelanotide is the drug often called PT-141.

excerpts.quote: ZOLOFT is indicated for the treatment of the following [See Clinical Studies (14) ] : • Major depressive disorder (MDD) • Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) • Panic disorder (PD) • Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) • Social anxiety disorder (SAD) • Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)
excerpts.note: Premature ejaculation is not on the list.

excerpts.quote: Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric and young adult patients in short-term studies. Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening, and for emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors
Sertraline can prolong IELT of PE patients, improve sexual satisfaction rates of patients and spouses, but increase risk of gastrointestinal upset.
excerpts.source: Yi et al., Medicine (Baltimore), 2019 (pooled analysis of 14 trials)
excerpts.note: IELT is the time to ejaculation. The trials were small and short; this use is off-label.
